alerts.name: Ifritah - Elevated 5xx responses
alerts.description: Notify when five or more 5xx request completions occur in ten minutes.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_logs_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND event_type = 'http.request.completed' AND status_class = '5xx'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Panic or exception recovered
alerts.description: Notify when a recovered panic or bounded exception event is emitted.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_logs_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (event_type = 'http.panic_recovered' OR panic_type IS NOT NULL OR exception_type IS NOT NULL)

alerts.name: Ifritah - Authentication rejection burst
alerts.description: Notify when rejected auth decisions exceed the pilot threshold.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_logs_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND event_type = 'auth.decision' AND outcome = 'rejected'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Migration or deployment failure
alerts.description: Notify on a failed deployment operation, including migration stage failures.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_logs_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND event_type = 'deployment.operation' AND outcome = 'failure' AND deployment_stage IN ('migration', 'backup', 'image_swap', 'verify', 'rollback')

alerts.name: Ifritah - Request latency budget
alerts.description: Notify when the average request duration exceeds the pilot budget.

query_condition.sql: SELECT AVG(duration_ms) AS alert_value FROM "ifritah_logs_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND event_type = 'http.request.completed'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Collector drops or lag
alerts.description: Notify when collector drops, queue pressure, parse failures, or lag are observed.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_telemetry_health_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (dropped_records > 0 OR parse_failures > 0 OR lag_ms > 60000 OR queue_depth > 1000)

alerts.name: Ifritah - OpenObserve health degraded
alerts.description: Notify when collector or OpenObserve health is degraded or failing.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_telemetry_health_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (component IN ('collector', 'openobserve') OR service_name = 'openobserve') AND outcome IN ('degraded', 'failure', 'dropped')

alerts.name: Ifritah - Resource pressure
alerts.description: Notify when a resource metric reports a bounded pressure value.

query_condition.sql: SELECT MAX(value) * 100 AS alert_value FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_container_cpu_usage_ratio'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Container memory pressure
alerts.description: Notify when an approved container role's aggregate working set exceeds the 1 GiB pilot threshold.

query_condition.sql: SELECT MAX(value) AS alert_value FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_container_memory_working_set_bytes' AND host_role = 'deployment'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Filesystem or disk pressure
alerts.description: Notify when an allow-listed filesystem reports less than 10 GiB of available/free space.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND host_role = 'deployment' AND metric_name IN ('node_filesystem_avail_bytes', 'node_filesystem_free_bytes') AND value < 10737418240

alerts.name: Ifritah - Container restart loop
alerts.description: Notify when the bounded container-role restart counter increases by three or more within ten minutes.

query_condition.sql: SELECT SUM(delta) AS alert_value FROM (SELECT container_role, MAX(value) - MIN(value) AS delta FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_container_restarts_total' AND host_role = 'deployment' GROUP BY container_role) AS restart_deltas

alerts.name: Ifritah - Host memory pressure
alerts.description: Notify when host available memory falls below the 512 MiB pilot threshold.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND host_role = 'deployment' AND metric_name = 'node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes' AND value < 536870912

alerts.name: Ifritah - Host resource metrics health
alerts.description: Notify when the node-exporter host resource baseline provides fewer than four CPU samples during the evaluation window.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND host_role = 'deployment' AND metric_name = 'node_cpu_seconds_total'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Resource exporter health
alerts.description: Notify when the resource exporter provides no healthy heartbeat during the evaluation window.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_resource_exporter_up' AND value >= 1

alerts.name: Ifritah - Resource exporter scrape errors
alerts.description: Notify when the resource exporter's cumulative scrape-error counter increases during the evaluation window.

query_condition.sql: SELECT MAX(value) - MIN(value) AS alert_value FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_resource_exporter_scrape_errors_total'

alerts.name: Ifritah - Telemetry gateway heartbeat missing
alerts.description: Notify when the telemetry gateway provides no healthy heartbeat during the evaluation window.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_gateway_up' AND value >= 1

alerts.name: Ifritah - Telemetry gateway health
alerts.description: Notify when the bounded telemetry gateway's cumulative failure counters increase during the evaluation window.

query_condition.sql: SELECT SUM(delta) AS alert_value FROM (SELECT metric_name, signal, MAX(value) - MIN(value) AS delta FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name IN ('ifritah_gateway_forward_failures_total', 'ifritah_gateway_dropped_records_total', 'ifritah_gateway_oversized_payloads_total', 'ifritah_gateway_queue_write_errors_total') GROUP BY metric_name, signal) AS counter_deltas

alerts.name: Ifritah - Telemetry gateway authentication blocked
alerts.description: Notify when the telemetry gateway reports an active OpenObserve authentication block.

query_condition.sql: SELECT MAX(value) AS alert_value FROM "ifritah_metrics_v1" WHERE _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND metric_name = 'ifritah_gateway_auth_blocked'
